# Motion › Whip

**What belongs here.** A very fast move with motion blur hiding the seam.

**Examples.** whip pan, whip zoom

**Family test.** Do the pixels keep their shape while they move?

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).
